description: Meet the CYBEX Pallas G3 i-Size - the next generation of forward-facing safety that grows with your child from toddler to pre-teen. With its easy recline, plush comfort, and advanced safety technology, the Pallas G3 i-Size is a smart, future-ready choice for families who value safety and simplicity in equal measure.

product_name: Obaby Nika Mini Cot Bed - White Wash - No Mattress
description: The Obaby Nika Mini Cot Bed in White Wash & White offers a contemporary design, due to its clean lines and textured oak effect finish, that will fit perfectly in today’s modern nursery. The Nika cot bed has three mattress base positions, the highest allowing you to put down and pick up your newborn without straining your back through unnecessary bending. As your little one starts to develop and become more active, the mattress base can then be lowered by a further two positions keeping them safe and secure at all times while the teething rails protect their delicate first teeth. When your little one is standing confidently, the Nika can be easily transformed into a stylish toddler bed that still offers the familiarity they are used to and helps them to transition in an often-daunting time. Once transformed the toddler bed can be used until they are approximately four years old. Requires an Obaby 140 x 70cm mattress. The Optional mattress choices are fantastic for providing your little ones with optimum support. The Moisture Management Dual Core Mattress offers an impressive four sleep options thanks to the reversible core and cover meaning you can always choose the best combination for a perfect night’s sleep. The Pocket Sprung Mattress features individual pocket springs that are cleverly integrated to give increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep. Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one.

product_name: SnuzKot Skandi Cot Bed - Grey - No Mattress / No Mattress Protector
description: The SnuzKot Skandi range has to be our favourite here at NBS, we just love the uniqueness and boldness of the Scandinavian themed furniture. This SnuzKot Skandi Cot Bed in contrasting Grey features fun, eye-catching coloured slats with a natural wood inner frame - giving it a tailored look. Skandi Cot Bed can be used from birth and will grow with your little one. We love the grey side slats - adding a fun vibe to your little one's room. Use from birth to 18 months, you can then convert it into to a toddler bed up to 4 years and with the additional junior bed extension kit it will grow with your child up to the age of 10 years. This Skandi cot bed has been designed to really last through the years, made using natural beech wood without the use of MDF or veneer. The handy mattress base has 3 height positions, making it easy for parents to get their little one in and out without over-stretching. Lift your newborn baby from the highest point and as they grow and learn to sit and stand, the base can be lowered to help prevent them climbing out. Please note: this cot bed does not come with a mattress, you will need to purchase the SnuzKot Pocket Spring Mattress separately, or a mattress measuring 68 x 117cm

product_name: Lassig Heavenly Soft Swaddles - Happy Fruits - Pear - XL

product_name: Joie i-Trillo Car Seat - Shale

product_name: Cushy Puff Pregnancy Pillow - Mellow Yellow
description: Discover gentle, all-over support with the Cushy Puff Pregnancy Pillow – thoughtfully designed to bring comfort to every stage of your journey into motherhood. product_name: Tutti Bambini CoZee Air Bedside Crib - Scandinavian Walnut/Ecru - Crib

Portable, practical, and award-winning, the CoZee Air makes night time routines simple and stylish.

product_name: Silver Cross Nia Stroller - Champagne
description: The Silver Cross Nia Stroller in Champagne is the ultimate compact travel system for modern, on-the-go families. Compatible with the Silver Cross Glide car seat, Nia transforms into a complete travel system with ease. Available in Onyx, Conifer, Champagne, and Chocolate, it blends timeless style with practical innovation. Founded in 1877 in Yorkshire, Silver Cross brings over a century of engineering excellence and craftsmanship to every product — and Nia is no exception.

product_name: CYBEX Balios S Lux Newborn to Toddler Ultimate Bundle - Stone Grey / 1 x Base G
description: Make every stroll a joy with the CYBEX Balios S Lux Newborn to Toddler Ultimate Bundle - a complete travel system designed for modern family life. With this complete travel bundle, your family can enjoy safe, stylish, and comfortable outings every day - from first steps in the city to your first family adventures.

product_name: Obaby Maya 2 Piece Room Set - Slate + Natural - No Mattress
description: The Obaby Maya 2 Piece Room Set in Slate + Natural is inspired by Scandinavian design, featuring a clean-cut finish and two-tone colourway, making it the perfect addition for families looking to create a modern and stylish nursery. The Maya 2 piece room set consists of the Maya cot bed and changing unit. Suitable from birth, the Maya cot bed will grow with your little one. The top position of the three height-adjustable mattress base allows you to put your baby down with less pressure and strain applied to your back and as they develop and start to find their feet, you can maintain their safety by lowering the base. The Maya changing unit is the perfect storage companion with recessed handles, enabling you to easily put away and quickly locate your little one’s belongings. On top of the unit is a changing area that can be removed to create a stylish, flat-top chest of drawers that can be used for years to come. The Optional mattress choices are fantastic for providing your little ones with optimum support. The Moisture Management Dual Core Mattress offers an impressive four sleep options thanks to the reversible core and cover meaning you can always choose the best combination for a perfect night’s sleep. The Natural Coir/Wool Mattress provides a naturally springy feel whilst being extremely resilient, durable and breathable. Topped with a soft and luxurious lambswool that regulates body temperature and moisture for maximum comfort as well as being naturally hypoallergenic. The Pocket Sprung Mattress features individual pocket springs that are cleverly integrated to give increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep. Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one.

description: The Owlet Dream Sock™ in Mint offers parents the ultimate peace of mind. This baby monitor comfortably wraps around your baby's foot, providing real-time monitoring of your baby’s pulse rate, oxygen, sleep patterns, and more. Its advanced technology offers clinically-proven, medical-grade accuracy, while the connected Owlet Dream App delivers live readings directly to your mobile device and a nearby Base Station – both of which will notify users when your baby needs your immediate attention. Experience peace of mind with the Owlet Dream Sock™, where technology and safety harmonise seamlessly to deliver the perfect balance. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for use with healthy infants between 0-18 months and 5-30 lbs / 2.5-13.6 kg. Intended Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for routine, in-home surveillance of healthy infants by measuring oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate (PR). The Owlet Dream Sock™ software analyses photoplethysmography data to identify instances when the infant’s PR and/or SpO2 moves outside a preset range, and provides a notification to the caregiver, prompting them to assess the infant. The notifications and associated data are intended to supplement the decision by caregivers to seek additional guidance for medical care of the infant. The feature is not intended to replace traditional methods of diagnosis and/or treatment. Indications for Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for use in healthy infants/children ages 0 to 18 months and weighing between 2.5-13.6kg in the home environment. It is not indicated for use with infants previously diagnosed with chronic cardiovascular and/or respiratory conditions. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for the detection and notification of hypoxia when measured SpO2 levels fall below 80%, as well as the detection and notification of tachycardia and bradycardia when PR levels are measured above 220 BPM or below 50 BPM, respectively.

product_name: Voksi Huddle Zip On Baby Carrier - Clay
description: Meet the Voksi Huddle Zip-On Baby Carrier – designed to make carrying your baby feel as natural and simple as putting on a jacket. Created for life with little ones from newborn through to toddler (3.2–15kg), Huddle removes the complexity often associated with baby carriers. There are no long straps to thread, no confusing adjustments, and no need to lift it over your head. Instead, it slips on effortlessly and secures in place with an intuitive zip system, giving you full front access and a smooth, stress-free start to babywearing. Thoughtfully designed in Norway and tested by real families, Huddle supports both parent and baby ergonomically. The fixed back panel helps ensure an even, balanced weight distribution, while your baby is supported in a natural, healthy sitting position from the very first weeks. Made from breathable, all-season materials, it keeps your baby close and comfortable year-round, while adapting as they grow – from cosy inward-facing cuddles to curious outward-facing adventures when they’re ready.

product_name: Shnuggle Bobbin Buoy Bath Thermometer
description: Make bath time feel a little calmer with the Shnuggle Bobbin Buoy Bath Thermometer - a clever floating thermometer designed to bring extra reassurance to your daily routine. Thoughtfully created to help take the guesswork out of bath time, it provides quick and accurate water temperature readings so you can focus on enjoying those special splash-filled moments together. With no buttons and no complicated setup, simply place the Bobbin Buoy into the water and it automatically activates. The easy-to-read digital display and intuitive colour-coded light indicator provide instant visual reassurance, helping you quickly check when the water temperature is within the recommended 32–37°C range for babies. Its floating upright design allows you to keep an eye on the temperature throughout bath time, while the simple tap-to-refresh function makes checking the water as it cools quick and effortless. Beautifully designed with a modern, minimal look, it’s a practical everyday essential that fits seamlessly into family life.

product_name: Bugaboo Cub Complete Pushchair - Heritage Black
description: Designed for families who love to explore, the Bugaboo Cub Complete Pushchair combines trusted Bugaboo quality with everyday practicality. Lightweight yet durable, this all-terrain pushchair offers exceptional comfort from day one, making every outing feel effortless, whether you're navigating busy streets, countryside paths or weekend adventures. Your newborn can rest comfortably in the spacious all-season carrycot, complete with breezy ventilation panels and a dual-sided PureBreeze™ mattress that helps regulate temperature throughout the year. As your child grows, the Cub transitions seamlessly into an ergonomic, reversible seat with multiple recline positions, providing lasting comfort and support for every journey. Large puncture-proof wheels, full suspension and responsive one-hand steering ensure a smooth ride across a variety of surfaces, while the generous underseat basket keeps all your essentials close at hand. Thoughtfully designed with durable recycled materials, PFAS-free fabrics and a repairable modular construction, the Bugaboo Cub is a more conscious choice for modern family life without compromising on performance or style.

product_name: CYBEX Beezy Pushchair - Chocolate Brown
description: The CYBEX Beezy Pushchair is a compact city pushchair for parents who want everyday ease with a polished CYBEX look. Suitable from birth to approx. 4 years, it gives little ones a comfortable ride while keeping busy days simpler for you. It combines an ergonomic lie-flat recline with an integrated leg rest, one-hand compact fold, all-terrain wheels and all-wheel suspension. It is also travel system ready, so you can attach a compatible CYBEX infant car seat, and the one-pull harness helps make every outing feel quicker. From school runs to town trips, the Beezy is made to be easy to store, easy to carry and comfortable on the move. The XL UPF50+ sun canopy and spacious shopping basket add the kind of practical touches that make a real difference day to day. With more than 25 years of CYBEX research, design and testing behind it, and over 500 awards across safety, quality and style, this is a thoughtfully made pushchair that feels dependable, durable and well suited to modern family life.

product_name: Avionaut Maxspace Airflow Car Seat - Mint
description: Meet the Avionaut MaxSpace AirFlow Car Seat - thoughtfully designed to support your growing little one with comfort throughout every season. Suitable from 100–150cm (approximately 15–50kg), this forward-facing car seat combines practical everyday features with breathable materials designed for year-round use. Featuring innovative AirFlow mesh fabric, the MaxSpace AirFlow is designed to encourage air circulation around your child, helping create a comfortable environment in changing temperatures. With a reclining adjustment for a more relaxed resting position and flexible installation using either ISOFIX or vehicle seat belts, it offers a practical solution for everyday family journeys.

product_name: UPPAbaby RIDGE V2 Pushchair - James - James
description: Built for families who love to get out and go, the UPPAbaby RIDGE V2 is a true all-terrain pushchair designed to make every journey feel smooth, supported and effortlessly comfortable. From everyday strolls to weekend adventures, its patented suspension system and never-flat tyres ensure a beautifully steady ride across pavements, park paths and more rugged ground. Wherever life takes you, RIDGE V2 is ready to follow. Thoughtfully designed for both parent and child, it features a supportive deep seat with lumbar cushioning, adjustable ventilation, and a UPF 50+ canopy to keep little ones comfortable in every season. With clever storage throughout, including a generous under-seat basket and handy pockets, everything you need stays close to hand. Practicality is at its heart too. The one-hand fold makes packing up simple, while the responsive disc brake and swivel-lock front wheel give you complete confidence and control on every terrain. From birth to toddlerhood, RIDGE V2 grows with your family. Use it with a UPPAbaby Bassinet or compatible infant car seat from day one, then adapt it as your child grows - even accommodating a second rider with the PiggyBack® Board. Whether you're navigating busy streets or exploring off the beaten track, the RIDGE V2 is designed to keep up with every step of your journey together.

product_name: Love To Dream Swaddle Up (1.0 Tog) - Grey - S
description: Love to Dream's multi-award-winning Swaddle Up™ is thoughtfully designed to support your little one’s natural arms-up™ sleep position, allowing them to access their hands for safe self-soothing. With its hip-healthy design and unique wing shape, Swaddle Up™ has been shown to help babies enjoy longer, more restful sleep—giving you precious peace of mind.* Self-soothing is a natural way for babies to settle back to sleep without needing extra help from a caregiver. Many little ones instinctively bring their hands to their mouth or gently rub their cheeks for comfort. The Swaddle Up™'s unique wing design nurtures this instinct, helping your baby feel secure and settled for a better night’s sleep. As your baby grows and begins showing signs of rolling, it’s time to transition to arms-free sleep. The Swaddle Up™ Transition Bag makes this change gentle and easy, helping your little one adjust smoothly while still feeling comforted and secure. Based on a 2017 survey of 1,242 Australian Love To Dream™ customers.

Carefully crafted from bamboo and organic cotton it will feel comfortable against their delicate skin. The MORI signature material is incredibly breathable and thermoregulating, making sure your baby is warm in winter and cool in summer.

product_name: Mushie Suction Toy - Hexapop - Shifting Sand - 10+ months

description: The Mushie Pacifier Case in Blush keeps little ones pacifiers in reach. With a loop to attach the case on to your changing bag or stroller, the Pacifier Case can carry up to 3 pacifiers.

description: The Mushie Silicone Bib in Bees will keep your little one comfortable and clean. With colourful, timeless patterns, the Silicone Bibs are practical and fun, and they feature rounded, built-in neck fasteners for a snug and comfy fit.

product_name: Tonies Hey Duggee
description: The Tonies Hey Duggee magnetically attaches to the Toniebox (sold separately), allowing you to listen to something different every time. product_name: Tutti Bambini Douglas The Highland Cow Rocking Toy
description: The Tutti Bambini Douglas The Highland Cow Rocking Toy is a very charming, lovable ride-on. Once a gentle giant of the Scottish Highlands, Douglas has thick, soft fur and lots of cuddles to bring to your little ones play room. More than that, Douglas promotes balance, coordination and motor skills through imaginative play. The sweetest companion.

product_name: Avery Row Baby Changing Bag - Natural
description: Meet the Avery Row Changing Bag – the perfect blend of style, practicality, and sustainability. Made from organic cotton canvas and recycled polyester, this eco-friendly bag is durable, lightweight, and built for busy parents on the go. Water-resistant fabrics make spills and messes easy to wipe clean, while the spacious interior and clever pockets keep nappies, wipes, bottles, and essentials neatly organised. The changing bag comes complete with pram clips for hands-free strolls and a soft cotton sateen lining in one of Avery Row's unique print designs. Ideal as a nappy bag, hospital bag, or day bag – with or without baby.

product_name: Joie Signature Estrella Twin Stroller - Maple
description: The Joie Signature Estrella Twin Stoller in Maple is a stylish, lightweight double stroller, featuring two customisable seats. It's perfect for navigating adventures with little ones who don't always see eye-to-eye. Suitable for little ones from birth to 22kg (approximately 4 years) the Estrella Twin Stroller has multiple recline positions, including a lie-flat recline, adjustable leg rests and durable, UPF 50+ and water-repellent canopies. The all-wheel suspension makes for a smooth ride and the lightweight frame and quick one-handed fold makes for an easy set up and put down. Featuring a SoftTouch 5-point harness, arm bar for curious little ones who like to lean forward, plush seat liners and a double wide storage basket, the Estrella Twin Stroller has everything you need.

product_name: Tonies Listen and Play Bag - PAW Patrol
description: The Tonies Listen and Play Bag in PAW Patrol is the perfect place to keep your Toniebox, headphones, charging station and 12 Tonies. Whatever your little ones' personality, these breathing exercises, visualisations, calming games and meditations will help them manage worries, encourage focus and make bedtime and waking up that bit more fun.

product_name: Tonies Peppa Pig - Learn With Peppa
description: The Tonies Peppa Pig Learn With Peppa character magnetically attaches to the Toniebox (sold separately), allowing you to listen to something different every time. Switch with different Tonie characters and quickly jump between audiobooks, music or your own interactive audio adventures. Peppa Pig’s obviously been listening to her teacher Madame Gazelle, because she’s here to help your little listeners learn all about the world. And all they need to do to get started is pop Peppa on top of a Toniebox. Featuring chapters about the Body, Emotions and Community, this Tonie is full of life lessons, tips and information, making it perfect listening for muddy-puddle-jumpers who are just beginning to explore the world. They can learn with Peppa while playing at home, pop her on when they’re snuggling up in bed, or listen in while on the road (providing Mr Bull isn’t digging it up). With this Tonie, there’s always an opportunity to find out something new. Because Peppa Pig loves learning. And so do they! This Tonie teaches: Community About the body Managing emotions Tracklist: All About Our World All About Emotions All About Community All About Being Creative All About My Body ⚠ WARNING. All Tonies contain magnets. Please keep them away from medical components such as defibrillators, shunts, or pacemakers as well as from products sensitive to magnets such as magnetic data carriers, credit cards, or computers.

product_name: BellaMoon 3-In-1 Pregnancy Pillow - Waterleaves
description: The BellaMoon 3-in-1 Pregnancy Pillow in Waterleaves has been designed to provide intense comfort to you and your growing bump throughout your pregnancy journey, to aid those pain prone areas and provide support to pressure points in your neck, back and hips. The Waterleaves design is inspired by the painting Waterlilies by Claude Monet with tones of green, purple and grey in the watercolour leaves. The C-shaped pillow measures 1.4m in length and is designed to elevate your limbs, to separate your hips and allow your spine to adopt a neutral position for sleeping during pregnancy. The 3-in-1 pillow has been specifically designed to last from pregnancy until baby is over a year old. Its unique modular design allows this pillow to be reconfigured for use during pregnancy, breastfeeding or bottle-feeding and baby development - giving parents that desired extended use. The 3 different functions of the BellaMoon® Pregnancy Pillow include; Pregnancy Pillow Nursing Pillow Baby Sitting Up Support

product_name: Purflo Breathe Pregnancy Pillow - Hazel
description: The Purflo Breathe Pregnancy Pillow in Hazel combines ergonomic shaping and luxurious breathable materials. Created using in-depth consumer research, the Breathe Pillow features Purflo's signature 3D spacer mesh and silky-soft interlock jersey cotton providing the ultimate comfortable maternity pillow. Super-versatile this design can be used as a back support, feeding cushion and as a baby support cushion for tummy time. Rather than traditional sausage-shaped construction, the Breathe Pillow features a central 3D spacer mesh panel that follows the natural shape of an expectant Mum. The top and bottom of the pillow are curved to support the head, hips, knees and ankles in all the right places. If used regularly from the start of the second trimester, pregnancy pillows can encourage baby to naturally get into the optimum position for birth.

product_name: Sleepytroll Baby Rocker Gen2
description: The Sleepytroll Baby Rocker Gen2 is a wonderful rechargeable baby rocker that comes with sound and motion sensors to help gently soothe your little one. The Baby Rocker Gen2 is designed to provide gentle, continuous rocking that effortlessly calms your little one, whether they're in a stroller, crib, or bouncer (adapters for cribs and bouncers available separately). You can enjoy up to 3 hours of comforting motion, all easily managed through a user-friendly app. With an impressive 12-hour battery life and built-in sound and motion sensors, Sleepytroll automatically responds when your baby stirs, helping them enjoy longer, more restful sleep. Ensure that the Sleepytroll is securely mounted on the handlebar and hangs vertically, with the sensors (located at the back of the Sleepytroll) facing the baby. Sleepytroll has been safety tested by TÜV, one of the world’s leading testing and certification organizations. It meets CE, FCC and RCM standards for electromagnetic field exposure and is ROHS (Reduction of Hazardous Substances) compliant.

product_name: CYBEX Gazelle S + Cloud G3 Travel System - Moon Black / Without Footmuff
description: Make every family outing effortless with the CYBEX Gazelle S + Cloud G3 Travel System. The versatile Gazelle S pushchair grows with your family, offering over 20 configurations so you can mix and match Gazelle cots, seat units, and your Cloud G car seat. Whether it’s a single ride or carrying two little ones, this pushchair adapts beautifully to your needs. Your baby rides in comfort in the award-winning Cloud G3 i-Size car seat, featuring an ergonomic lie-flat position, all-round air ventilation, and advanced linear side-impact protection. With its spacious under-seat basket plus detachable shopper basket (up to 23kg combined), a one-pull harness, adjustable handlebar, and smooth suspension, the Gazelle S ensures a comfortable ride for children and parents alike. From the park to errands, this travel system makes life with little ones easier and more enjoyable.

description: The Owlet Dream Sock™ in Dusty Rose offers parents the ultimate peace of mind. Its advanced technology offers clinically-proven, medical-grade accuracy, while the connected Owlet Dream App delivers live readings directly to your mobile device and a nearby Base Station – both of which will notify users when your baby needs your immediate attention. Experience peace of mind with the Owlet Dream Sock™, where technology and safety harmonise seamlessly to deliver the perfect balance. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for use with healthy infants between 0-18 months and 5-30 lbs / 2.5-13.6 kg. Intended Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for routine, in-home surveillance of healthy infants by measuring oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate (PR). The Owlet Dream Sock™ software analyses photoplethysmography data to identify instances when the infant’s PR and/or SpO2 moves outside a preset range, and provides a notification to the caregiver, prompting them to assess the infant. The notifications and associated data are intended to supplement the decision by caregivers to seek additional guidance for medical care of the infant. The feature is not intended to replace traditional methods of diagnosis and/or treatment. Indications for Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for use in healthy infants/children ages 0 to 18 months and weighing between 2.5-13.6kg in the home environment. It is not indicated for use with infants previously diagnosed with chronic cardiovascular and/or respiratory conditions. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for the detection and notification of hypoxia when measured SpO2 levels fall below 80%, as well as the detection and notification of tachycardia and bradycardia when PR levels are measured above 220 BPM or below 50 BPM, respectively.

product_name: Cybex Cloud G3 Plus Car Seat - Moon Black - No Base
description: The Cybex Cloud G3 Plus in Moon Black is an AGR-certified infant car seat designed for babies from birth to approximately 24 months (up to 13 kg). Built for modern families who refuse to compromise on safety or convenience, this rear-facing car seat features an ergonomic lie-flat position that supports your baby's natural posture and healthy hip development from day one. The 180-degree rotation and one-click release make getting your little one in and out effortless, even one-handed. The Linear Side-impact Protection System (L.S.P.) delivers 15% more side-impact protection, while the modular G3 system means one Base G3 works with both the Cloud G3 and Sirona G3 toddler seat, covering your child from birth through age 4. The Plus fabric features a meticulously engineered 3D mesh structure that is up to six times more breathable than comparable materials, reducing humidity and keeping your baby fresh on every journey. A removable newborn inlay, machine-washable covers, and a UPF50+ XXL sun canopy complete the package. With over 25 years of expertise and more than 500 design and safety awards, CYBEX brings trusted German engineering and a sleek, modern aesthetic to every family journey.

product_name: UPPAbaby CRUZ V3 + Pebble 360 Travel System - Evelyn / Without Bassinet / With FamilyFix 360 Base
description: The UPPAbaby CRUZ V3 + Pebble 360 Travel System is the perfect combination of style, safety, and everyday practicality – thoughtfully designed to support you and your baby from day one. The updated CRUZ V3 pushchair brings a sleek, streamlined design without compromising on performance. Suitable from 6 months, or from birth with the Infant Insert or Carrycot (optional add-on), it offers a full-size, reversible seat with one-hand, multi-position recline and a from-birth lie-flat option for newborns. A water-repellent, extendable canopy with UPF 50+ protection keeps your little one shaded and cool, while zip-out ventilation and a peekaboo window add comfort and visibility. The tapered harness system with magnetic buckle makes securing your growing child quick and simple. Premium touches like the adjustable full-grain leather handlebar, one-handed compact fold, and extra-large storage basket (up to 13.6 kg) are designed to make every outing smoother. With enhanced all-wheel suspension and never-flat tyres, the CRUZ V3 delivers a smooth, stable ride on any surface. The Maxi-Cosi Pebble 360 is built for ease, safety, and comfort from birth to approx. 18 months (40–83 cm). As part of the 360 Pro Family, it rotates smoothly when used with a compatible base (optional add-on), making getting your baby in and out of the car completely fuss-free. With ClimaFlow ventilation, breathable mesh fabrics, and a cosy newborn inlay, the Pebble 360 ensures your baby is always comfortable. The adjustable headrest adapts as your child grows, offering optimal protection and support from their very first journey. Whether you’re strolling through town or heading out on a family adventure, the CRUZ V3 + Pebble 360 Travel System offers the ultimate in comfort, safety, and convenience for your growing family - right from the very first day.

product_name: Nuna TRIV NEXT + PIPA URBN Travel System - Caviar
description: For families who love simplicity without compromising on comfort or style, the Nuna TRIV NEXT + PIPA URBN Travel System is designed to make everyday journeys feel beautifully easy from the very beginning. product_name: Lassig Knitted Baby Comforter - Tiny Farmer Goose

Then, of course, there is no more searching for the pacifier: The pacifier can be attached to the legs of the little companions and reliably, remains in its place. It is an ideal gift for newborns.

Extras like the Donkey 6 Organizer, Footmuff, Cup Holder+, and car seat adapters complete this bundle for worry-free outings.

product_name: Lansinoh Silicone Milk Storage Bags - Clear - 240ml
description: The Lansinoh Silicone Milk Storage Bags offer a reusable, eco-conscious way to store your breastmilk safely at home or on the go. Made from durable platinum food-grade silicone, these flexible pouches are designed to stand upright for easy filling or lie flat to maximise freezer space. A secure double-seal closure helps prevent leaks, giving you peace of mind whether storing fresh or frozen milk. Thoughtfully designed for everyday convenience, each bag features a wide opening for easy pouring and cleaning, plus a large write-on area with an included chalk marker to help you keep track of dates and quantities. Washable and dishwasher safe, they’re a practical, sustainable alternative to single-use storage.

product_name: Tonies The Scarecrow's Wedding
description: Bring story time to life with The Scarecrow’s Wedding, a heartwarming tale from much-loved author Julia Donaldson and illustrator Axel Scheffler. Little listeners can follow Harry O’Hay and Betty O’Barley as they plan their dream wedding day, filled with love, laughter and a few unexpected twists along the way. When the mischievous Reginald Rake tries to spoil their special day, Harry must set off on a brave adventure to save the celebration. With playful rhymes, memorable characters and a gentle message about kindness and teamwork, it’s a story little ones will want to enjoy again and again. Simply pop the Tonie on your Toniebox for a magical, screen-free listening experience that’s perfect for cosy moments at home or winding down before bed. Tracklist: 01 - The Scarecrow's Wedding Complete Story 02 - The Scarecrow's Wedding Song 03 - The Scarecrow's Wedding Listening Game 04 - The Scarecrow's Wedding Instrumental 05 - The Scarecrow's Wedding Read-Along ⚠ WARNING. All Tonies contain magnets. Please keep them away from medical components such as defibrillators, shunts, or pacemakers as well as from products sensitive to magnets such as magnetic data carriers, credit cards, or computers.

product_name: Maxi-Cosi Zero G Travel System with Fame Cabin & Coral Slide Pro - Sapphire Sand / No Carrycot / No Bumper Bar

product_name: The Little Green Sheep Twist Natural Cot Bed Mattress 70x140cm
description: The Little Green Sheep Twist Natural Cot Bed Mattress 70x140cm has been beautifully handmade for your precious newborn baby in the most natural way. Using only the highest quality natural materials, the Dual-Sided Twist Mattress core has been designed to provide little ones with the natural comfort they need for the best night's sleep. Featuring a firm supportive core for your baby as recommended by safe sleep experts, the Dual-sided Twist Mattresses offer the ultimate in natural comfort, with a durable yet supportive layer of latex for even support and weight distribution as they grow from a baby to toddler and beyond. A layer of natural latex (derived from the Hevea tree) is blended with the naturally occurring mineral graphite to provide comfy, progressive support that makes for a natural alternative to memory foam. This layer works with the coconut coir core to provide the correct progressive support for your toddler as they grow. Use this side up for toddlers. The mattress core is created from thousands of coconut fibres blended together with natural latex to act as thousands of tiny springs, providing support and reducing pressure points. product_name: Love to Dream Swaddle Up (2.5 Tog) - White Dreamer - NB
description: Love to Dream's multi-award-winning Swaddle Up™ is designed to support your baby’s natural arms-up™ sleep position, giving them access to their hands for safe self-soothing. The Swaddle Up™ Transition Bag makes this gentle shift easier for both you and your baby. *Based on a 2017 survey of 1,242 Australian Love To Dream™ customers.

product_name: Maxi-Cosi Oxford+ Premium + Pebble 360 Pro 2 Travel System (9 pieces)
description: The Maxi-Cosi Oxford+ Premium Travel System is designed to provide comfort, safety, and ease for families on the move. Featuring premium materials and thoughtful details, this 9-piece bundle includes the Oxford+ pushchair, carrycot, footmuff, changing bag, cup holder, rain cover, car seat adapters, Pebble 360 Pro i-Size car seat, and FamilyFix 360 Pro slide-out base. The Oxford+ ensures your little one rides in comfort from day one up to 4 years (22kg). The spacious carrycot features a reversible high-density foam mattress and ClimaFlow ventilation, while the pushchair seat offers an ergonomic recline and cushioned inlay for ultimate relaxation. The extendable UPF 50+ canopy with a sun visor provides optimal shade, and the state-of-the-art suspension guarantees a smooth ride on any terrain. Ease of use is at the heart of the Oxford+ design. The push-push brake system allows for hands-free activation, keeping shoes clean and protected. The Pebble 360 Pro car seat, designed for maximum safety and comfort, features a full lie-flat recline in all modes, allowing for restful naps in the car and on the pushchair. The FamilyFix 360 Pro base with SlideTech® technology makes getting your baby in and out of the car effortless—simply slide, spin, and go. With one-hand 360° rotation and an easy-in harness that stays open, securing your little one is seamless. The car seat meets the latest i-Size (R129/03) standards, offering G-CELL Side Impact Protection and an anti-misuse rotation lock for rearward-facing travel up to 18 months. Every journey is made easier with the Oxford+ Premium Travel System. Whether you're navigating city streets or heading out on family adventures, this thoughtfully designed bundle ensures your little one stays safe, secure, and comfortable at every stage. What’s new with the Oxford+? This updated version now features the innovative Sense carrycot, designed with extra space and a breathable memory foam mattress to keep little ones comfy on every journey. With handy memory buttons for easier transitions and a clever collapsible design, the Oxford+ is perfect for families on the go.

product_name: UPPAbaby CRUZ V3 + Pebble 360 Pro 2 Travel System - Evelyn / Without Bassinet / With FamilyFix 360 Pro
description: The UPPAbaby CRUZ V3 + Pebble 360 Pro 2 Travel System offers a premium, all-in-one solution for growing families – combining award-winning design, next-level comfort, and effortless practicality for life on the go. The CRUZ V3 is a sleek, compact full-size pushchair that’s made for everyday ease. Suitable from 6 months or from birth with the Carrycot or Infant Insert (optional add-on), it features a reversible toddler seat with multi-position recline, lie-flat function, and adjustable leg rest – so your little one can nap, play, or explore in total comfort. The extendable UPF 50+ sun canopy includes zip-out fabric, ventilation panels, and a peekaboo window – keeping baby cool and shaded in all seasons. With an upgraded tapered harness system, magnetic buckle, and an adjustable leather handlebar, the CRUZ V3 brings everyday luxury to family travel. Engineered for performance, the CRUZ V3 includes all-wheel suspension, never-flat tyres, and a front wheel lock for a smooth ride across city streets and country paths. A one-step fold and self-standing design make storage easy, and the spacious 13.6kg under seat basket ensures room for every essential. The Pebble 360 Pro 2 is Maxi-Cosi’s most advanced infant car seat yet – offering full lie-flat recline in and out of the car, and the ability to rotate and slide toward you when used with the FamilyFix 360 Pro base (optional add-on), thanks to SlideTech® technology. It’s designed to reduce strain on your back and make everyday trips smoother. Built with ClimaFlow ventilation, breathable foam, and mesh fabrics, it keeps your baby cool and comfortable, while the removable newborn inlay and adjustable headrest provide a perfect, secure fit from 40–87cm (birth to approx. 18 months) – even for premature babies. Together, the CRUZ V3 and Pebble 360 Pro 2 create a stylish, future-ready travel system that makes every journey simpler, safer, and more comfortable from day one.

product_name: BabyBjörn Bouncer Bliss Woven Mélange - Light Grey - No Bouncer Toy
description: The BabyBjörn Bouncer Bliss Woven Mélange in Light Grey offers a safe and cosy haven for your little one. The ergonomic bouncer provides gentle rocking which is powered by your baby’s movements, so you can have a little time hands-free. The gentle rocking is comforting for very little ones, then as your baby grows and learns how to control the rocking, the rocking becomes fun and challenging, stimulating your baby's balance and motor skills. The bouncer has 3 recline positions, so you can adjust as baby grows - it'll take you all the way from newborn, up until 2 years. The Woven Mélange fabric is super soft and comfortable, quick-drying and stylish. The bouncer is lightweight and easy to move around, so great for at home or to take to a friends house. The fabric is removeable and washable, and the fabric seats are interchangeable, so you could keep a spare, or refresh the bouncer for a new baby. Extra fabrics seats and a travel bag are available separately.

product_name: BabyBjorn Bouncer Bliss - Woven - Anthracite - No Bouncer Toy
description: The BabyBjorn Bouncer Bliss in Woven Anthracite is a cosy space for your baby to play and rest in. When baby kicks their legs or waves their arms, the baby bouncer rocks gently. Playing in the baby bouncer also helps your baby develop their motor skills and balance. It can be used from newborn and up to the age of 2 years. Ergonomic design: The baby bouncer gives good support to your baby’s back, neck and head. The fitted fabric seat distributes your baby’s weight evenly, which is particularly important for newborn babies. Bouncer (max. 9 kg): Always use the restraint system. Make sure that both buttons are locked. You can adjust between two positions. Stop using the product as a bouncer once your child can sit up without help. Chair (max. 13 kg): Use as chair when your child can walk and sit on his or her own. In order to convert the product into a chair, all you have to do is turn the fabric around.

Sleep, feed, and be closer to your baby with the SnüzPod 5.

product_name: Obaby Astrid Mini Cot Bed - White - No Mattress
description: The Obaby's Astrid Mini Cot Bed is an opulent cot bed that has sleek lines. This design also comes with handleless drawers and doors for optimal convenience; you can contribute effortless practicality and style when decorating your dream nursery. The Astrid will grow with your little one, it's suitable from birth until approximately 4 years old with its adjustable base height. Allow yourself and your beloved little one to bask in the captivating beauty of Nordic heritage with a little help from Obaby's Astrid Cot Bed–Satin. With peace of mind, you know your little one is safe, sound and comfortable as they drift off into their sweet dreams, night after night. With the Obaby Astrid Cot Bed, you can pick between three mattress options: no mattress, pocket sprung mattress and the moisture management mattress. The Obaby Pocket Sprung Mattress is fantastic for providing babies with optimum support and luxurious levels of comfort during their slumber. Individual pocket springs are cleverly integrated to give increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep. Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one. These individual springs are then encased in a high-grade of dent-resistant nursery foam ensuring superior comfort. The cover is made of flat-weave microfibre which is delicately soft to the touch and breathable yet refreshingly durable. The Obaby Moisture Management Dual Core Mattress adapts as your little one grows and is fantastic for providing little ones with optimum support. The mattress offers an impressive four sleep options thanks to the reversible core and cover meaning you can always choose the best combination for a perfect night’s sleep. The Mattress is suitable from birth, one side of the mattress is firm which aids in muscle development, and bone growth and features an inner core comprised of coconut coir, bonded with natural latex that provides a naturally springy feel whilst being extremely resilient, durable and breathable. It is then topped with a soft and luxurious lambswool that regulates body temperature and moisture for maximum comfort as well as being naturally hypoallergenic. As your little one grows, so do their needs. This mattress can be flipped, one side offering individual pocket springs encased in high-grade, dent-resistant nursery foam. The other side gives increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep, promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams.

product_name: Obaby Nika Mini 2 Piece Room Set - Grey Wash - No Mattress

Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one.

The most premium cot bed mattress. The Silver Cross TrueFit™ Premium Mattress is hypoallergenic and breathable with a dual-sided design featuring 220 pocket springs for support and comfort from birth to beyond.

product_name: Owlet Dream Sock™ - Bedtime Blue
description: The Owlet Dream Sock™ in Bedtime Blue offers parents the ultimate peace of mind. This baby monitor comfortably wraps around your baby's foot, providing real-time monitoring of your baby’s pulse rate, oxygen, sleep patterns, and more. Its advanced technology offers clinically-proven, medical-grade accuracy, while the connected Owlet Dream App delivers live readings directly to your mobile device and a nearby Base Station – both of which will notify users when your baby needs your immediate attention. Experience peace of mind with the Owlet Dream Sock™, where technology and safety harmonise seamlessly to deliver the perfect balance. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for use with healthy infants between 0-18 months and 5-30 lbs / 2.5-13.6 kg. Intended Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is intended for routine, in-home surveillance of healthy infants by measuring oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate (PR). The Owlet Dream Sock™ software analyses photoplethysmography data to identify instances when the infant’s PR and/or SpO2 moves outside a preset range, and provides a notification to the caregiver, prompting them to assess the infant. The notifications and associated data are intended to supplement the decision by caregivers to seek additional guidance for medical care of the infant. The feature is not intended to replace traditional methods of diagnosis and/or treatment. Indications for Use The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for use in healthy infants/children ages 0 to 18 months and weighing between 2.5-13.6kg in the home environment. It is not indicated for use with infants previously diagnosed with chronic cardiovascular and/or respiratory conditions. The Owlet Dream Sock™ is indicated for the detection and notification of hypoxia when measured SpO2 levels fall below 80%, as well as the detection and notification of tachycardia and bradycardia when PR levels are measured above 220 BPM or below 50 BPM, respectively.

description: The LolaLykke Bamboo Maternity Support Band in Black, This pregnancy support belt is a must have for expecting mums. How it works During pregnancy, we experience many uncomfortable symptoms, including lower back pain, pelvic girdle pain and SI joint pain. A maternity support band can help ensure a pain-free pregnancy and support your overall wellness and recovery.The gentle compression of the pregnancy girdle helps support the uterus and reduces discomfort from movement during physical activity. In addition, this pregnancy belly support belt provides external cues to your body to facilitate proper posture during pregnancy, the extra weight carried in front of the body and combination with the stretching and weakening of key core muscles that support the spine may lead to a lack of core stability. Maternity support belt provides your core the support it needs, correcting your posture and reducing pains as a result. Over 2/3 of expecting mothers experience back and pelvic pains during pregnancy, but there is no need to just put up with discomfort. the pregnancy support belt helps reduce overall stress on the body during pregnancy and can help get you through your daily activities with less pain.

product_name: SnuzKot Skandi Cot Bed - White - No Mattress / No Mattress Protector

Lift your newborn baby from the highest point and as they grow and learn to sit and stand, the base can be lowered to help prevent them climbing out. Please note: this cot bed does not come with a mattress, you will need to purchase the SnuzKot Pocket Spring Mattress separately, or a mattress measuring 68 x 117cm

product_name: smarTrike Traveler Active Stroller - Black

For travel convenience, the Traveler folds quickly, making it easy to store and transport—perfect for family trips by car, bus, train, or plane. Plus, with a simple push of a button, the Traveler effortlessly transforms from a stroller to a trike, giving your child the freedom to pedal and explore. The Traveler is more than just a stroller; it’s a versatile, long-lasting experience that grows with your child.

product_name: Obaby Nika Mini 3 Piece Room Set - Grey Wash + White - Pocket Sprung Mattress
description: The Obaby Nika Mini 3 Piece Room Set Grey Wash & White offers a contemporary design, due to its clean lines and textured oak effect finish, that will fit perfectly in today’s modern nursery. This adorable, stylish bundle includes The Obaby Nika Mini Cot Bed, Nika Changing unit & Nika Double Wardrobe. The Nika cot bed has three mattress base positions, the highest allowing you to put down and pick up your newborn without straining your back through unnecessary bending. As your little one starts to develop and become more active, the mattress base can then be lowered by a further two positions keeping them safe and secure at all times while the teething rails protect their delicate first teeth. When your little one is standing confidently, the Nika can be easily transformed into a stylish toddler bed that still offers the familiarity they are used to and helps them to transition in an often-daunting time. Once transformed the toddler bed can be used until they are approximately four years old. Requires an Obaby 120 x 60cm mattress. The Nika changing unit is a piece of furniture that can be used for years to come. Three large full-depth drawers offer plenty of space for changing essentials, toys and your little one’s precious possessions. All three drawers feature two brushed metal handles and glide on smooth runners allowing you to easily open them with either hand. The Nika double wardrobe features one large cupboard space, with two sturdy hanging rails for all of your little one’s special outfits, fronted by a pair of soft close doors. Underneath the main cupboard area is a single 33L capacity drawer providing the perfect storage solution for those items that cannot be hung up. Stylish brushed metal handles are used throughout the piece making sure it is simple to use. The Optional mattress choices are fantastic for providing your little ones with optimum support. The Moisture Management Dual Core Mattress offers an impressive four sleep options thanks to the reversible core and cover meaning you can always choose the best combination for a perfect night’s sleep. The Pocket Sprung Mattress features individual pocket springs that are cleverly integrated to give increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep. Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one.

description: The SnüzPod 5 Bedside Crib in Cashmere is the crib you love, now even better with some exciting new features to make life with your baby easier, more comfortable, and a little bit more stylish. The SnüzPod has been trusted by parents around the world, supporting over a million precious dreams, and the new SnuzPod 5 is everything parents already adore, but with lots of clever improvements to make those early months even smoother. Here’s what’s new: Fresh New Colours: A range of beautiful, soft shades to match your nursery and give you even more choice than before. Even Easier to Use: Setting up and adjusting the SnüzPod is simpler than ever. Plus, the incline and transition from bedside to standalone mode is now quicker and easier. More Room for Baby: With a larger sleep space and mattress (17% bigger than the SnüzPod⁴), your little one will have plenty of space to sleep soundly. Better Visibility & Airflow: Bigger mesh windows (21% larger than before) mean better breathability and a clearer view of your baby – so you can check in on them without disturbing their sleep. Easier to Move Around: With optional castors, you can roll the SnüzPod easily from room to room – perfect for keeping your baby close, wherever you are. Lighter Bassinet: The bassinet is now 15% lighter, so it’s super easy to lift off and move around the house. The SnüzPod 5 still has everything you loved about the original – safety, flexibility, and style – but now with even more thoughtful features to make life as a new parent a little bit simpler. Sleep, feed, and be closer to your baby with the SnüzPod 5.

product_name: MORI Ribbed Two Way Zip-Up Sleepsuit - Rose - 0-3m
description: The MORI Ribbed Two Way Zip-Up Sleepsuit in Rose has been designed to make changing quick and easy - with just one zip up and down - no tricky poppers. Made from bamboo and organic cotton for the softest and safest feel on a baby’s sensitive skin, it's also breathable and thermoregulating for a night of safe sleep. The zip fastening is made from non-metal nylon and concealed from the inside to ensure no catching on the skin and to avoid any unnecessary irritation for the baby. Foldover mitts are included for sizes under 9 months to make sure your little one doesn’t accidentally scratch themselves.
